name: empty input
ref: the loop of the ROR13 API hash: no bytes, hash 0

name: two bytes: the first byte is rotated
ref: h = ror(0x41, 13) + 0x42; bits 0 and 6 move to bits 19 and 25

example.title: Two bytes show the rotation
example.note: The first byte is rotated 13 bits before the second is added, which gives 02080042 for the two letters AB.

name: LoadLibraryA with its terminating zero

example.title: The loop applied to LoadLibraryA and its zero byte
example.note: This is the plain loop over the name and its terminating zero. A stub hash also mixes in the module hash, so it is not this value.
